description: commit c3cc3cd (STARTTLS) reformatted main.rs startup blocks into dense single-line if-let chains (e.g. 'let store = match secretx::from_uri(key_path) { Ok(s) => s, Err(e) => { error!("{e}"); std::process::exit(1); } };') with no diagnostic context. The original code had distinct error messages ('tls.key_path: invalid secretx URI', 'tls.key_path: secretx retrieval failed'). The refactored version emits bare '{e}' with no field name or context, making production errors harder to diagnose. Fix: restore distinct, contextual error messages at each failure point.
title: smtp/main.rs: startup error messages compressed to single-line if-let chains
